verses.1: So, you, my son, be strong in the grace that comes from Jesus Christ.
verses.2: And what I have heard from many witnesses: these things must be presented to faithful people, so that others may also be able to teach them.
verses.3: Be like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
verses.4: No one who is leading a army gets involved in the affairs of life just to please those who make military plans.
verses.5: And if anyone competes in the race, they will not be awarded any prizes unless they actually compete according to the rules.
verses.6: The farmer who is cutting the crops should take over the first ones from among the fruits.
verses.7: I say this: For the Lord will give you peace in all things.
verses.8: I remember Jesus Christ, who was raised from the dead, from the lineage of David, according to my gospel.
verses.9: In whom I will act maliciously until I am bound, as a villain. But the word of God shall not be denied.
verses.10: Therefore, I endure all this because of those who have been chosen, so that they too may receive salvation through Jesus Christ, with glory forever.
verses.11: It’s a true statement. For if we die together, then we will also speak together.
verses.12: If we agree, then we will cooperate with each other. If we refuse, then he will also refuse us.
verses.13: If we are truthful, then he remains honest. He cannot deny it.
verses.14: He understood these things, and he protested before the lord, saying that it was not wise to engage in such a foolish battle, which would only lead to the destruction of those who listened.
verses.15: Let him test himself to show his worth to God, as a worker who is not discouraged, and who rightly follows the words of truth.
verses.16: And they will surround those who are truly empty of words. For most of all, they will lead to acts of disrespect and violation of rules.
verses.17: And their words will also establish a law like that of the Gyngrían. What is meant by this is that Hymenaeus and Philetus are involved in this.
verses.18: They hesitated regarding the truth, saying that it had already happened in the past, and they were changing their beliefs about it.
verses.19: But he was the solid foundation of God’s kingdom, bearing this seal upon him. He is the Lord of all beings. May those who call himself “Lord” be freed from all injustice.
verses.20: In a large house, it’s not only gold and silver items that are used; there are also wooden and stone objects. Some of these are used for decoration, while others are used for practical purposes.
verses.21: If someone cleans himself up from these things, he will be a worthy and honorable person, useful to his master, and ready for any good work that may be required of him.
verses.22: But he avoided those modern desires. He pursued justice, faith, love, and peace, along with those qualities that make a person worthy of being called a “Lord” with a pure heart.
verses.23: But those who are stupid and uneducated should be rejected. You know that they will only cause trouble.
verses.24: A slave of a lord, however, does not need to fight. Instead, he should be kind and respectful towards everyone else. He should act in a way that is honorable and just.
verses.25: In teaching those who are being tested, may the God give them a deeper understanding of what is true.
verses.26: And they will be rescued from the prison, and brought under his control, to serve his desires.
